g.text: Greenﬁeld, brownﬁeld, and legacy modernization all run on the same Semantic Engineering principles
Universal principles applied across every use case
CONTINUOUS SDLC · same four-layer graph, live curation
Live application, scope is a moving target
Impact-aware change against the live graph
Bounded project, target ﬁxed up front
Deﬁned and governed by the custodians from a blueprint
Product Owner · Architect · UX · Engineering (same four roles)
Migration under parity contract · four validation gates
Five-phase delivery · bounded, then Maintain mode
On completion, a modernization graph converts into the four-layer ontology so the modernized system continues under continuous SDLC.
